invariants.title: Durable contracts remain authoritative
invariants.description: The browser never becomes a Project database. Every displayed business state is rebuilt from Project, Feature, Pipeline, document, audit, Agent, governance or execution stores.

invariants.title: No Agent control from the Web
invariants.description: Web routes and bridge methods cannot start, cancel, retry, approve, configure or grant permissions to an Agent execution. Registered Agents and orchestrations are read-only observations.

invariants.title: Signed documents are immutable
invariants.description: A project manager decision links to an exact document and JSON pointer but never rewrites that document; corrections require a new framework production or sequence.

invariants.title: Loopback security is deny by default
invariants.description: The server binds only to loopback, authenticates every API and event request, checks Origin, constrains all filesystem access to verified Project roots and emits no prompts, secrets, stderr or terminal logs.

invariants.title: Live signals are invalidations, not truth
invariants.description: Watch events are debounced hints. Reconnection and every invalidation reload a complete durable snapshot; heartbeat indicates liveness only and never becomes invented progress.

invariants.title: One renderer and one bridge
invariants.description: Document presentation is schema-driven and shared across document types; UI components depend only on NornBridge so phase 2 Tauri does not duplicate screens or business projections.

invariants.title: English contracts, bilingual interface
invariants.description: Routes, IDs, API data and contracts remain canonical English. Human labels and formatted values use complete key-parity EN/FR catalogs, and machine data is locale independent.

invariants.title: Non-developer honesty
invariants.description: The UI shows coverage, freshness and missing evidence explicitly and does not claim provider connectivity, cryptographic seals, costs, remaining time or reproducibility without corresponding contracts.
